translations.10: Workspace within which everyone can see is called 'hiroba' (Commons).
translations.11: The Commons can be accessed by anyone to post notes.
translations.12: Kojiyayu-san shares the sales schedule every morning on the Commons.
translations.13: You can invite members to the Space by email.
translations.14: The invited person receives a confirmation email.
translations.15: Once approved by the administrator, they can join immediately.
translations.16: Members’ permissions can also be changed in the ‘Space’.
translations.18: Notes are automatically saved and synchronized across all devices.
translations.19: You can edit them offline and they sync immediately when you connect.
translations.2: Memotto is a note-taking app that can consolidate text, charts, and images into one place.
translations.20: You can revert to a previous state from the page history.
translations.21: Tsukimori-san recovered a piece of text she accidentally deleted.
translations.23: It's convenient to pin important pages.
translations.24: Pinned pages will be listed at the top of the list.
translations.25: The notes in the hub become easier to find when you tag them.
translations.27: Kotori Tsubaya is dividing tags by project.
translations.28: The same tag can be used in one thing.
translations.29: In the search, you can search for both the platform and individual items simultaneously.
translations.3: This guide will explain using the examples of Public Relations’ Yamashiri-san and Sales’ Takanashi-san.
translations.30: If you cannot find it, please broaden the search range.

translations.5: 月見里さんは、会議の決定事項をひとことに残しています。
translations.6: 月見里さんは、大事な箇所に付箋を貼って目印にしています。
